report_name: Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach from AI-Powered 'Agentic' Attack

threat_actors.name: Unnamed External Actor
threat_actors.description: An external actor that employed sophisticated, autonomous AI agents, described as 'offensive agentic techniques', to breach Chainalysis's internal systems and exfiltrate customer PII.
threat_actors.goals: Acquire customer PII from Chainalysis to enable future sophisticated social engineering or phishing campaigns against high-value targets.

attack_patterns.name: Vulnerability Scanning
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent likely performed automated vulnerability scanning to find an entry point into Chainalysis's systems.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent likely exploited a public-facing application to gain initial access into Chainalysis's systems.

attack_patterns.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
attack_patterns.description: The primary objective of the attack was to gather identity information (PII) about Chainalysis's customers, including full names, email addresses, and organizational roles.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent may have used compromised or newly created accounts to navigate internal systems after gaining initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The AI agent likely used a web service to exfiltrate the stolen customer PII from Chainalysis's network.

tools.name: Offensive AI Agent
tools.description: An autonomous AI system described as using 'offensive agentic techniques' to autonomously perform reconnaissance, identify vulnerabilities, execute exploitation, and exfiltrate data with minimal human intervention.

identities.name: Chainalysis
identities.description: A blockchain intelligence firm that was the victim of a data breach executed by an AI agent, resulting in the exposure of its customer data.

identities.name: Chainalysis Customers
identities.description: Customers of Chainalysis across government, finance, and law enforcement whose PII (full names, email addresses, and organizational roles) was exposed in the data breach.
